description: Erection of a rear extension at second floor level, over part of the existing back addition; removal of the remaining pitched roof of the existing back addition at second floor level to form a roof terrace over part of the new flat roof enclosed with 1.7 metre high obscure glazed screening; installation of 1no. external air conditioning unit within external acoustic housing on the remaining proposed flat roof of the existing back addition at second floor level; enlargement of 1no. side-facing window and installation of 2no. sets of French doors and Juliet balconies to replace existing windows to the rear elevation at first floor level; replacement of 2no. rooflights in the front roofslopes with 6no. rooflights, replacement of 1no. rooflight in the rear roofslope, replacement of 1no. rooftlight on the main flat roof with 2no. rooflights; and replacement of existing windows to the front elevation to match existing.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawing numbers, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

- 420.PR02.B;
- 420.PR03;
- 420.PR11.B;
- 420.PR12.B;
- 420.PR13.B;
- Noise Impact Assessment prepared by Parker Jones Acoustics received 19 April 2026;
- Acoustic screening specifications received 19 April 2026.

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

	- Dormers: Lead surround.
	- Pod extension walls: Slate tiles.
	- Party wall: London stock brick to match existing.
	- Replacement windows: Timber framed, painted white.
	- Doors: Powder coated aluminium framed or timber frame.

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.  

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4, DC6 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 4 - Prior to the occupation of the development hereby permitted, the side-facing windows and glazed door at first floor level in the west elevation as shown on drawing no. 420.PR12.B shall be fitted with obscure glass to a minimum level of obscurity equivalent to Pilkington Texture Glass Level 3, and shall be non-opening and fixed shut up to a height of 1.7m above the finished floor level. The window shall thereafter be permanently retained as approved.
	
To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers in terms of privacy and overlooking in accordance with Policy HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).


To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers in terms of privacy and overlooking in accordance with Policy HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).


Condition : 5 - The balustrades of the Juliet balconies at first floor level in the southwest elevation [drawing no. 420.PR11.B] hereby permitted shall be fixed flush with the rear elevation of the building at the same time as the associated doors are installed. The doors to the Juliet balconies shall open inwards only. The doors and balustrades shall be permanently retained in this form for the lifetime of the development.  

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance and to protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers in terms of privacy and overlooking, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 6 - The terrace hereby approved shall not be first used until the privacy screening has been installed as shown on approved drawing nos. 420.PR11.B and 420.PR12.B. The privacy screen shall achieve a minimum level of obscurity equivalent to Pilkington Texture Glass Level 3 and shall have a height of 1.7m above the finished floor level of the terrace along the west, south and east elevations. The privacy screen shall thereafter be permanently retained as approved. 

To protect the amenities of neighbouring occupiers in terms of overlooking and privacy in accordance with Policy HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 7 - The roof of the extension and the remainder of the roof of the existing back addition, other than the area shown as a terrace on the approved plans, shall not be converted into or used as a terrace or other open amenity space. No alterations shall be carried out; nor planters or other chattels placed on the remainder of the roof of the back addition or the extension hereby approved. No railings or other means of enclosure shall be erected around the roofs and no alterations shall be carried out to the property, including the extension hereby approved, to form an access onto the roofs.  

Such a use would be detrimental to the amenities of neighbouring properties by reason of overlooking and loss of privacy and potential noise and disturbance, contrary to Policies CC11 and HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).


Condition : 8 - The external sound level emitted from the air conditioning unit hereby approved shall be lower than the lowest existing background sound level by at least 10dBA in order to prevent any adverse impact. The assessment shall be made in accordance with BS4142:2014 at the nearest and/or most affected noise sensitive premises, with all machinery operating together at maximum capacity.

To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site and surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise, in accordance with Policies CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 9 - Prior to use, machinery, plant or equipment, extract/ ventilation system and ducting at the development shall be mounted with proprietary anti-vibration isolators and fan motors shall be vibration isolated from the casing and adequately silenced and maintained as such.

To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site and surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise and vibration, in accordance with Policies CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).
